back: A standard for comparing grazing needs; commonly one mature cow of about 450 kg; other animals count as fractions.
The number of LU actually kept on an area: LU/ha or ha/LU.
The number of LU an area can support long-term without damaging vegetation or soil.
Carrying capacity (LU) = area (ha) ÷ hectares needed per LU.
Rest = days per paddock × (number of paddocks − 1).
Good grasses die out, erosion, bush encroachment, underfed animals, more worms, long-term land degradation.
Mechanical clearing, chemical (arboricides), browsers such as goats, fire, correct stocking.
Burn only where old grass has built up, in calm weather, with fireguards; rest the area afterwards.
Cut-and-carry feeding of penned animals: high output per hectare and manure collected, but high labour.
